Topic                 Item      Checklist item description                                                                                                                            Reported on Line

Title                  1        The diagnosis or intervention of primary focus followed by the words “case report” . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .                                 Yes/P.1
Key Words              2        2 to 5 key words that identify diagnoses or interventions in this case report, including "case report" . . . Yes/P.2
Abstract              3a        Introduction: What is unique about this case and what does it add to the scientific literature? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.2, 3

(no references)       3b        Main symptoms and/or important clinical findings . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4, 6
3c        The main diagnoses, therapeutic interventions, and outcomes . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4-7
3d        Conclusion—What is the main “take-away” lesson(s) from this case? . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.11
Introduction           4        One or two paragraphs summarizing why this case is unique (may include references) . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.10
Patient Information   5a        De-identified patient specific information. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4-7
5b        Primary concerns and symptoms of the patient. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4, 6
5c        Medical, family, and psycho-social history including relevant genetic information . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4, 6
5d        Relevant past interventions with outcomes . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4, 6
Clinical Findings      6        Describe significant physical examination (PE) and important clinical findings. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4, 6
Timeline               7        Historical and current information from this episode of care organized as a timeline . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4, 6
Diagnostic            8a        Diagnostic testing (such as PE, laboratory testing, imaging, surveys). . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Yes/P.4, 6
Assessment
8b        Diagnostic challenges (such as access to testing, financial, or cultural) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
No.
8c        Diagnosis (including other diagnoses considered) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
Yes/P.4, 6
8d        Prognosis (such as staging in oncology) where applicable . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
No

review.content_class_rationale: Opened the 1-page PDF (rendered to PNG): the CARE case-report reporting checklist with items 1 to 13 and a "Reported on Line" column of manuscript page references (Yes/P. entries and a few No entries); informed consent is ticked Yes.
review.notes: Manuscript reporting-compliance form; contains no patient-level clinical content (only manuscript page references and a ticked informed-consent box).

limitations: Machine draft: every review block must be completed by a reviewer who inspected the content.
